title: Why Does the Human Brain Consume 20% of Your Oxygen?

scenes.text: Why does the human brain consume 20% of your oxygen?

scenes.label: IT'S ONLY 2% OF BODY WEIGHT
scenes.text: Even though it’s only about 2% of your body weight, it uses a fifth of the oxygen you breathe.

scenes.label: HIGH ENERGY DEMAND
scenes.text: Neurons fire millions of times per second, requiring glucose and oxygen to keep electrical signals flowing.

scenes.label: NO OXYGEN, QUICK FAINT
scenes.text: If oxygen drops just a few percent, you can lose consciousness in seconds because the brain can’t store it.
scenes.query2: low oxygen brain loss of consciousness

scenes.text: Follow so you never run out of fun facts.

description: Your brain is a tiny organ with a massive appetite for oxygen. Discover why it hogs a fifth of every breath you take. Follow for more mind‑blowing facts!
